name: default-off paged request state transaction and age-ordered prefill admission
source_repository: original mlx2 implementation based on local codex/varlen-paged-attention revision 04ab0b218f87af42fe59b66b75ff3b4e95e25ad9
license: original mlx2 project code; no third-party implementation copied
modifications: The optional pack chooser now honors caller age order among feasible prefill offers after reserving decode/verify rows. Added a per-request protocol for a private candidate, revision-bound accepted-prefix preparation, and one atomic publish of requested KV, GDN, QSA and MTP planes. Unsupported atomic capability, unselected lanes and default-off requests refuse before beginning a candidate. Cancellation and exceptions discard private state.
validation: CPU-only fake-owner tests cover accept-zero/partial/all, four-plane publication, age fairness, decoder deadline, default-off and capability refusals, cancellation, invalid acceptance, exception rollback, failed publish and revision mismatch. Focused paged scheduler and request transaction tests passed 13/13 on Python 3.11.
limitations: The atomic publish guarantee is a required adapter contract, not an implemented concrete cache owner. No normal serving request invokes this coordinator. No GPU, native array, model decoding, multi-lane atomic publication, selected route, observed use, or qualification is claimed. The measured PackPrice identity and actual deadline budget must be supplied and verified by serving integration.
